title: Chhote Sarkar
desc: Amar, a rich businessman, is framed by two undercover police officers, Seema and Jagmohan, for the murder of his uncle. To evade prison, he claims to be of unsound mind and tries to solve the mystery.

title: Ab Insaf Hoga
desc: A determined man rises against corruption and injustice, risking everything to protect innocent lives while challenging powerful enemies through courage and fearless action.

title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
desc: Raj and Simran meet in Europe. Simran's family arranges her marriage. Raj, encouraged by his father, follows her to India. He strives to win over her family, including her father, for their blessings.

title: Ab Ke Baras
desc: Anjali travels to India to investigate recurring visions of her past life, where she encounters a thief who may have been her lover in a previous lifetime, drawing them into a mysterious connection.

title: Bewaffa Se Waffa
desc: Rukhsar asks her best friend Nagma to marry her husband, Aslam, to bear him a child. Trouble arises as Nagma's relatives stir discord, threatening their harmony.

title: Ishk Actually
desc: Gia's life gets complicated when her former lover, Neil, reappears. Over time, she realizes that true happiness comes from following her heart.

title: Naagin Bani Suhaagan
desc: Vaishali, blessed to become a shapeshifting snake, faces heartbreak when destiny forces her to fight the very man she deeply loves, tearing her between love and duty.
